Written technical scope

Every engagement begins with a concise written scope defining inputs, target metrics, deliverables and acceptance criteria before work starts.

Commercial clarity

Pricing, milestones, intellectual property ownership and confidentiality terms are agreed per engagement in writing. This website processes no payments or automatic subscriptions.

Open-source core & private preview

The `yanki` Python core is licensed under MIT on GitHub and provided 'as is'. Hosted Yankı Cloud Gateway capabilities are currently under active development and offered selectively to design partners.
